CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_customer_orders(
    p_customer_id INTEGER
)
RETURNS TABLE (
    order_id INTEGER,
    order_date DATE,
    total NUMERIC,
    status VARCHAR(50)
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT o.id, o.order_date, o.total, o.status
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.customer_id = p_customer_id;
END;
$$;
